Lore matches the wiki (curly quotes on the scan and the wiki). Base JP-L-ultimatum.gif 350 px only; copyright Jabba's Palace 1998 line ('1998 DECIPHER INC.' legible per vs8/23). No modern remake of this card on the wiki (VB3 Luke's Ultimatum is a different card). Slip text matches the stub.
